metric.strong: share of pixels whose largest RGB channel difference exceeds 64 after a 3x3 box blur of both images (ImageDiff)
metric.mean: mean largest RGB channel difference without blur, 0-255
metric.heightDifference: absolute native/Cordova height difference in device pixels (density 2)

rule: a comparison passes when the widths are equal, strong <= recorded + margin.strong, mean <= recorded + margin.mean and the height difference <= recorded heightDifference + margin.heightDifference
recordedOn: 2026-11-13; Robolectric SDK34 native graphics, source 45e616f1 with measured-size test extension; actual API36 Cordova captures.
why: Size-specific glyph rasterization and fractional label-width differences. The 360dp layout has six rows of 17 shortcuts in a smaller image, so error fractions exceed the old 384 budget. At 320dp there are 11 shortcuts. Every icon/card/shortcut/location rectangle is independently checked with the unchanged 0.5dp position/height, 1dp button position and 1.5dp text-width limits. Selected overlays inspected at all sizes; no layout displacement or lost content. Existing margin unchanged.
